LESSON: WRITING 3.4.1 HANDWRITING: LEGIBILITY AND NEATNESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.4: Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How does being unable to read other people’s work make you feel? 2. Why should you ensure your written work is easy to read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: learner writes words legibly, neatly and spells them correctly.

● Digital literacy: learner use online dictionaries to find out the spelling of words.

Values:
● Love: is shown as the learners share correctly spelt words with peers.

● Responsibility: the learner uses the digital devices appropriately.

Link to other subjects

The learner is able to relate the concept of writing legibly and neatly in Kiswahili.
